name: Monosoul
source:
A short, multiple-ending VN with a simplistic art style.

If you happen to find the story weirdly interesting or want answers:

There is a LOT of hidden subtle / not-so-subtle details in every part of the game, and in tandem you can get a good idea as to who Moon may be and the world she inhabits. [I](If you do find it interesting and want to know more)[/i]  A little forewarning - things are not as they seem, nor as they seem that they seem.

[From [url=https://lufas.itch.io/monosoul]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个简短的、多结局的VN，具有简单的艺术风格。

如果你碰巧发现这个故事非常有趣或想要答案：

游戏的每个部分都有很多隐藏的微妙/不那么微妙的细节，同时你可以很好地了解月亮可能是谁以及她居住的世界。[I]（如果你确实觉得它很有趣并且想了解更多）[/i] 一点警告 - 事情并不像它们看起来那样，也不像它们看起来那样。

[来自[url=https://lufas.itch.io/monosoul]Itch.io[/url]]
